observations: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show the same physical game case for NBA 2K20 on a PS4 disc case.
The case is held by a hand in a domestic setting with a 'Prezin' sign in the background.
The game case is sealed with a clear plastic shrink-wrap.
The case is marked with a yellow sticky note in photo 0 and photo 1, and a white sticker in photo 2.
The case shows some minor surface wear and scuffs.
The game disc is not visible in any of the photos.

claims.evidence: The developer is not clearly legible on the case in the photos.

risks.proof: A photo of the digital storefront page showing the price and purchase date.

risks.risk: The game may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN) or have a digital account lock.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the PSN dashboard showing the game is online and owned.

Photo of the digital storefront page for NBA 2K20 on PSN.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
